done_when: Claim files carry a lease (expires_at); sync.py and gemini_queue treat an expired lease as free and refresh it while working; a task named by a card id is always claimed (B2 kept only for free-text tasks); tests cover crash-then-reclaim and two takers of a new-file card (second refused).
goal: Claims are already atomic (git push compare-and-swap with a guard re-check, sync.py push_claim_commit). Fix the two gaps around them: a crashed holder blocks a card until a human releases it (10-30 fabervaale-cvd-sweep), and the B2 rule skips the claim for new-file cards, so two workers can take the same card.
